identity.name: Ristorante Aurora Capri
identity.evidence: The official site's rendered contact section labels Aurora separately from Mia Capri enoteca at Longano, 10. Use Aurora's address and contacts.

contact.navigation: Open the homepage and select CONTATTI. Direct navigation to /contatti returns HTTP 404, while in-app navigation renders the contact page.

excludedContacts.reason: Separately labelled Mia Capri enoteca, not the restaurant contact block.

bookingRoute.evidence: No booking form or booking-labelled link observed on the inspected home/contact views. Official phone and email are general contacts, not proof of reservation acceptance.
bookingRoute.limitation: Inspection does not prove absence of other booking channels or current seasonal opening.

tests.method: Headless Chromium via Playwright; service workers blocked; all non-GET and unreviewed XHR/fetch requests blocked; no contact links activated or forms submitted.
tests.translation: Initial conservative pass blocked static assets/i18n/it.json. Reviewed that JSON and allowed only its exact GET URL before repeating the contact inspection.
limitations: No messages, calls, reservations, holds or payments.
No Velvet integration or production test; this is a per-restaurant evidence fragment.

next: Booking coordinator should consolidate verified identity and general contact route. Prefer homepage for external navigation; do not expose /contatti as a direct link or present these contacts as a verified booking channel. Obtain explicit official booking evidence before changing bookingRoute from unknown.
